sprint.title: Information Resolution Core V1a
sprint.goal: Implement the owner-authorized read-only information core and offline validation; submit an uncommitted handoff for owner acceptance.
scope: Composable in-memory information, stable identity, supplied current/history, selective relationships, hidden binding constraints, epistemic availability and character access; no production integration or mutation.
No Region Pack edits/contracts, persistence/save changes, F01/F05 rewrites, providers, general adjudication or V1b. No Git staging, commit, merge, push or publication.
verification: Syntax, focused offline representative and reference-catalog tests, relevant F01/F05 regressions, lifecycle/preflight and diff integrity.
